tender.title: Independent Children's Advocacy Service
tender.description:
Dumfries and Galloway Council (the Purchaser) wishes to commission children's advocacy services that:
- are independent and professional;
- provide individual (one-to-one) advocacy that is issue focused; and
- meet statutory requirements and Scottish Executive priorities.
The service will covers such services under the following categories:
- Advocacy services for children and young people who are or have been looked after and accommodated within or outwith the region (excluding those who are placed locally by another Local Authority) up until the age of 26.
- Advocacy for children and young people on the Child Protection Register.
- Advocacy for children and young people in terms of the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003.

lots.description:
This procurement is to obtain a suitable advocacy service provider for children's advocacy services. The service objectives are as follows:
To provide an independent and confidential advocacy service to include information, support and advice for Dumfries and Galloway children and young people who are or have been looked after and accommodated within or outwith the region.
To provide access to an advocacy service for children & young people regardless of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, faith/religion, or social background.
To match service users and advocates appropriate to each situation’s needs, seeking specialist support where indicated and ensuring service users comfort at all times.
To ensure that children & young people’s own views are heard and adequately represented.
To provide advocacy, related support and information in an age-appropriate and child/young person-centred manner.
To help children and young people to access and understand information relevant to them and make appropriate choices or decisions which give them fuller control of their lives.
To promote choices to young people.
To support children & young people who, because of incapacity or communication difficulties, may not be able to express their needs or views.
To provide advocacy for children and young people who have a mental disorder in compliance with the Mental Health Act.
To guide children and young people towards self-advocacy and avoid creation of dependency.
To develop links with service providers, professionals and relevant support organisations to ensure clear understanding of the role of advocacy.
To develop and promote children and young people’s involvement in service planning.

tender.title: PKC14238  Central Heating Upgrade Phase 6
tender.description:
Perth & Kinross Council (‘the Council’) is seeking to appoint suitably qualified and experienced contractors to carry out central heating life cycle replacement works on PKC’s domestic tenanted properties.
The works comprise of the like-for-like replacement of gas boilers and radiators, full gas boiler systems inclusive of radiators and pipework; replacement of electric storage and panel heating systems, as well as the replacement of existing storage heating, electric wet boilers, and solid fuel heating with Air Source Heat Pumps. This list is not exhaustive. The full scope of works will be set out in the Employer’s Requirements within the tender documentation.

criteria.description:
4B.4 Bidders will be required to state the values for the following for the last two financial years:
1.            Current Ratio (Current Assets divided by Current Liabilities)
2.            Net Assets (Net Worth) (value per the Balance Sheet)
4B.5.1.a Bidders must confirm they already have, or can commit to obtain, prior to commencement of the contract Professional Risk Indemnity Insurance.
4B.5.1b Bidders must confirm they already have, or can commit to obtain, prior to commencement of the contract Employer’s Liability Insurance.
4B.5.2 Bidders must confirm they already have, or can commit to obtain, prior to commencement of the contract Public Liability Insurance.
criteria.minimum:
The acceptable range is:
1.	Current Ratio - it is expected that the ratio is equal to or greater than 1, i.e. Current Assets will equal or exceed Current Liabilities for both years. Reasons for not meeting the required test to be disclosed by tenderers together with appropriate supporting evidence to confirm the suitability of the tenderer for the contract.
2.         Net Assets (Net Worth) - it is expected that the Net Worth will be positive, i.e. a Net Assets position for both years. Reasons for not meeting the required test to be disclosed together with appropriate supporting evidence to confirm the suitability of the tenderer for the contract.
4B.5.1.a Bidders must confirm they already have, or can commit to obtain, prior to commencement of the contract Professional Risk Indemnity Insurance in the sum of 2,000,000 GBP for any one occurrence or series of occurrences arising out of one event.
4B.5.1b Bidders must confirm they already have, or can commit to obtain, prior to commencement of the contract Employer’s Liability Insurance in the sum of 10,000,000GBP for any one occurrence or series of occurrences arising out of one event.
4B.5.2 Bidders must confirm they already have, or can commit to obtain, prior to commencement of the contract Public Liability Insurance in the sum of 5,000,000 GBP for any one occurrence or series of occurrences arising out of one event.
